title: The Whale
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'The Whale,' the office experiences a mix of humorous interactions, character conflicts, and revelations. Andy shares personal stories, Angela suspects her husband’s infidelity, and Jan confronts her past with the office characters. The episode features character-driven humor, relationship tensions, and unresolved conflicts that hint at ongoing storylines.
